Formed the view that the development proposal is of state significance as it satisfies the HDA SSD criteria.

The proponent is to provide analysis and information that supports a proposed approach to affordable housing as part of the SSD merit assessment process. The Department will work with the proponent to determine an approach to affordable housing that reflects the expectation that there is value returned to the community from the significant uplift achieved above existing planning controls.
Noted there are no member conflict of interests.
